scope: All four Ruth records in the pinned QDR biblical dataset; published Qumran-Digital lines checked by assigned reviewer. Not all known Ruth witnesses or a complete diplomatic collation.
comparison_method: Read whole fragment contexts; compare consonants with canonical WLC source fields, keeping supplied, uncertain and unassigned text separate. Character-diff output used only for navigation, not attestation.
canonical_manifest_serialization: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON mapping all 85 sorted relative Ruth YAML paths to file SHA256; sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')

line_accounting.unassigned: frg.2 has traces without a secure biblical alignment

line_accounting.qualification: frg.1-3 line1 has an unresolved opening bracket boundary; line6 has only unassigned traces in the published display although raw QDR tags its five no-letter tokens Ruth1:6

application.review_scope: Independent local context/policy and SIL/UBS reading; relies on root for 2Q16 and Greek observations. Approved exact full-verse correction with retained prepositional alternative in note. Not historical-priority or deployment approval.

source_distinction_checks.source_evidence: Ruth 2:21 הַנְּעָרִים; compare 2:8 נַעֲרֹתָי, 2:22 נַעֲרוֹתָיו, 2:23 בְּנַעֲרוֹת, and masculine הַנְּעָרִים twice in 2:9.
source_distinction_checks.proposed_text: Then Ruth the Moabite said, “He also said to me, ‘You are to stay close by my young men[a] until they have finished all my harvest.’”
source_distinction_checks.rationale: Approve the complete verse as a change from current text. It preserves the masculine/feminine wording contrast; the note acknowledges possible generic reference and retains the prepositional alternative. No exclusively male referents or narrative error are inferred.

source_distinction_checks.source_evidence: Ruth 2:21 עִם הַנְּעָרִים אֲשֶׁר לִי; neighboring verses use feminine נַעֲרֹתָי and נַעֲרוֹתָיו.
source_distinction_checks.proposed_text: Then Ruth the Moabite said, “He also said to me, ‘You are to stay close by my young men[a] until they have finished all my harvest.’”
source_distinction_checks.alternative_text: Then Ruth the Moabite said, “He also said to me, ‘You are to stay close by my workers[a] until they have finished all my harvest.’”
source_distinction_checks.rationale: Workers plausibly conveys generic reference. Prefer young men with the note qualification to expose the source-form contrast; workers remains a viable alternative, not an error.

source_distinction_checks.source_evidence: The source has הַנְּעָרִים rather than the neighboring feminine forms.
